note: Ordered steps. Each step is one Copilot turn or UI action in live Revit. 'expect' is what the driver must observe for PASS.

steps.expect: Result card lists doors; count > 0; elements highlighted in the view

steps.text: Find all elements with Mark equal to ZZZ-NOT-REAL
steps.expect: Result card reports 0 matches; no exception in the add-in log

steps.text: Click a row in the find result card
steps.expect: That element is selected and zoomed in the active view

steps.text: Set Comments to SMOKE-TEST on the doors on Level 1
steps.expect: Preview card shows N edits; model is unchanged (Comments not yet SMOKE-TEST)

steps.text: Click Apply on the preview card
steps.expect: Result card reports N applied, 0 failed; Comments read SMOKE-TEST on the doors

steps.text: Click Undo on the result card
steps.expect: Comments restored to the pre-commit values; one Revit undo entry consumed

steps.text: Click Redo on the result card
Click Undo again to leave the model clean
steps.expect: Comments restored; model has no net change

steps.text: How many walls are in the model?
steps.expect: Answer arrives while Revit stays responsive (no 'Not Responding'); count matches Revit schedule
